blockers.message: the review record has no `## code.review` section, while roles were active at it

findings.evidence: - A plugin system for export formats, so that PDF, XLSX, XML and JSON exports can be added later by dropping a module in `src/export/plugins/`.
findings.recommendation: The Why is only "Accountants copy invoices one by one into their spreadsheet at the end of each month." — a single CSV export answers it, and the design itself names that simpler option ("a single CSV function") and rejects it only as "not extensible", for formats no one requested. Drop the plugin registry from proposal.md#What Changes, the "Decision: Exports go through a plugin registry" in design.md and task 1.2 ("Plugin registry discovering `src/export/plugins/`"); implement CSV as a plain function behind the route. Start-up discovery of modules from a directory is also an unverified load-bearing mechanism that would vanish with it. Propose extensibility in its own change when a second format is actually requested.
findings.title: Plugin system for export formats nobody asked for

findings.evidence: The settings page SHALL let a user choose their preferred export format among the installed plugins.
findings.location: specs/invoice-export/spec.md#Requirement: Users choose their export format
findings.recommendation: Nothing in the Why asks for a per-user format preference, and with CSV as the only format the choice has nothing to choose between. The requirement is also not checkable as written: the scenario "A preference" says "**THEN** exports use CSV", yet the only export is `GET /invoices.csv`, which is CSV whatever the preference, so the test passes without the feature doing anything. Remove the requirement and its two scenarios, the third bullet of proposal.md#What Changes ("A settings page where each user picks their preferred export format."), the sentence "A settings page stores each user's preferred format." in design.md, `web/src/settings/` from proposal.md#Impact, and task 2.1.
findings.title: Settings page for a preferred export format nobody asked for

findings.recommendation: `GET /invoices.csv?month=YYYY-MM` exposes a whole month of invoices with customer names and totals in one request, and the spec has no scenario for who may call it (no unauthorized case); the plan also adds a settings page (`web/src/settings/`) storing a per-user preference. Every box is unticked with no reason, so no expert reviews them. Tick security and personal-data (or give the reason on the line), and tick user-interface as long as the settings page stays in scope (see R-skeptic-2); if it is removed, leave it unticked with that reason.
findings.title: Every domain unticked while the plan exposes invoice data and adds a UI page
